digest.component_or_area: reconciler coordinator outcome versioning and state advancement
propositions: Versioned lifecycle, retry, and fuse outcome sections must be rendered with exact pass tallies and cursor behavior while preserving existing mutation fields as an additive contract.

Cursor, baseline, binding, and last-pass state must advance only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work must remain eligible for re-observation and not be counted as applied.

The binding_store.repair_at_write_boundary call must remain ordered after ensure_selection_current staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch to avoid race conditions between retirement intent and live observation.
Mixed-pass tallies must be exact and disjoint: mutations_applied must be unfolded from the legacy combined count to report only genuinely applied mutations separately from recovered mutations.
All diagnostic fields and collections must be bounded and redacted of secrets to prevent unbounded or sensitive data leakage in preview, log, and manifest consumers.
The reconcile.py file must remain within the 800-line architectural cap after extracting the behavior-preserving write-boundary repair logic.
